success.description: A burning green fog descends upon the target engagement. Each target gains the Sluggish condition.

sigmarsComet.description: On each turn, while this card is recharging, you may move the fog as if spending a single manoeuvre.

conservative.requirements: 7 power, target engagement within medium range. If you are engaged with an enemy, add {Dm} to your pool. Special: Add {Dc} for each engagement beyond the first. Effect: Corrosive fog lingers at the target engagement while this card recharges. Any character starting his turn engaged with the fog suffers 2 normal wounds. Any character starting his turn within close range of the fog suffers 1 normal wound.
